tool_args.rationale: All six readings are at the target horizon, so horizon extrapolation is not the issue. The remaining ambiguity is whether the sink strengthens smoothly or activates only when input and gradient are jointly high. The trajectory batch is the only remaining listed response probe that can help resolve that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fit with the recalled saturation scale leaves training residuals as large as 0.24, well above the 0.045 tolerance.
The six rows do not independently vary input and sink gradient enough to identify activation separately from smooth attenuation.
Already acquired. Its low-gradient row constrains the baseline but does not distinguish how the sink activates.
